Name: Upstairs Plus Downstairs Organized Greenhouse
Author: oclarina
Description:
The sequel to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32161]Pragmatist's Organized Greenhouse[/url]. Now no longer pragmatic, but large enough to fit crops and trees from various mods with room to spare. Or just the vanilla crops and trees multiple times over.

The base layout has room for 80 trees and 12 iridium sprinklers, but there are options if that's still not enough.

[u][size=4][b]Config[/b][/size][/u]
[size=3]Upper Floor[/size]
﻿-Crops: Adds four more iridium sprinkler plots to the center of the upper floor.
﻿-Trees: Adds sixteen more tree plots to the center of the upper floor.
﻿-Mixed: Divides the space to add eight tree plots and two iridium sprinkler plots.
﻿-Empty: Leaves the center of the upper floor empty, so that you can decorate it or add machines there.
[size=3]Decor[/size]
﻿-Decor: Adds various plants and other decor pieces to the edges of the greenhouse, similar to the vanilla greenhouse design.
﻿-Empty: Leaves the greenhouse empty so you can decorate or utilize it as you like.

[u][size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size][/u]
This mod only edits the greenhouse interior map, so while it is incompatible with any other mods that edit the greenhouse, it is fully compatible with all other mod types, including those which add new crops or trees.
